name: command-retry
description: The remote-command transport is a raw http.get (the OK:-prefixed envelope cannot go through get_json), so it sits outside the built-in retry budget - and a transient 502 on system.find used to produce a green zero-asset run with one log line as the only signal. The hand-rolled bounded retry must repeat the command on a transient status and import normally when the console recovers: system.find answers 502 once and then the estate. request_count==3 (one findGroups, two system.find attempts) pins the retry; the asset pins the recovery. Every remote command is a read, so repeating it is safe.
